requirement.original: Edit tool的详情页面（左键点击进入之后），并没有像其他tool一样展示详情。需要Edit也展示和Read一样的完整详情页。
requirement.clarified: The Edit tool detail page (opened by clicking on an Edit tool call) should display the same standard sections as tools using the generic fallback (Description, Input Parameters, Output/Error), in addition to its existing diff view.
requirement.what: Add standard detail sections (Description, Input Parameters, Output, Error, Completed-no-output) to EditViewFull component while retaining the diff view
requirement.why: Edit tool detail page only shows a diff view, inconsistent with other tools like Read that show full structured details. Users expect consistent detail layout across all tool types.

included: Add Input Parameters section to EditViewFull
Keep existing diff view as a dedicated section
excluded: Changing the inline Edit tool view in message list

success_criteria: Edit tool detail page shows Description section when tool.description exists
Edit tool detail page shows Input Parameters as formatted JSON
Edit tool detail page shows diff view with red/green changes
Edit tool detail page shows Output section when completed with result
Edit tool detail page shows Error section when state is error
Visual styling matches the generic ToolFullView sections
constraints: Must use i18n t() function for all user-visible strings
Must use toolFullViewStyles for section styling consistency
Must use React.memo pattern matching existing component
Must follow 4-space indentation per project rules

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Edit tool detail page only shows a diff view (red removed lines, green added lines) without Description, Input Parameters, or Output sections
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: EditViewFull component (registered in toolFullViewRegistry) renders ONLY a ToolDiffView. When a specialized full view exists, ToolFullView.tsx line 30-31 renders it exclusively, completely skipping the generic sections (lines 33-93). EditViewFull was implemented as diff-only without the standard sections.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - original implementation design, not a regression
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: EditViewFull was designed to show the most useful information (the diff) but the standard sections were not included alongside it
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Users expect consistent detail layout across all tool types. Read tool (no specialized full view) shows Description + Input + Output via generic fallback, but Edit (has specialized full view) shows only the diff, losing context like file_path, parameters, and tool output/errors
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Present since EditViewFull was first implemented

file_contents.EditViewFull.tsx: 38 lines - renders only ToolDiffView with old_string vs new_string
file_contents.ToolFullView.tsx: 193 lines - if specialized view exists (line 30), renders ONLY it; else renders generic sections (Description, Input Params, Output, Error, No-output)
file_contents._all.tsx: toolFullViewRegistry has Edit: EditViewFull registered at line 53
file_contents.BashViewFull.tsx: 61 lines - another specialized full view, also diff-only (terminal output), also missing standard sections
file_contents.MultiEditViewFull.tsx: 118 lines - another specialized full view, also diff-only, missing standard sections
file_contents.knownTools.tsx: Edit tool input schema: file_path, old_string, new_string, replace_all

dependencies.ToolDiffView: Wrapper around DiffView with horizontal scroll and wrapLines setting
dependencies.toolFullViewStyles: Exported from ToolFullView.tsx - section, sectionHeader, sectionTitle, description, etc.
dependencies.CodeView: Used by generic fallback for Input Parameters and Output rendering
dependencies.Ionicons: Used for section header icons in generic fallback

development_approach.strategy: Modify EditViewFull.tsx to include the standard detail sections (Description, Input Parameters, Output, Error, No-output) from the generic ToolFullView fallback, placing the diff view as an additional section between Input Parameters and Output. Reuse the same styling patterns (toolFullViewStyles, Ionicons, CodeView) and i18n keys (tools.fullView.*) from the generic fallback.
development_approach.validation_approach: Build the app (yarn typecheck), then visually verify the Edit tool detail page shows: 1) Description section (if present), 2) Input Parameters as JSON, 3) Diff view with changes, 4) Output section (if completed with result), 5) Error section (if error state). Compare side-by-side with Read tool detail page for layout consistency.

research_findings.reason: Straightforward UI bug fix with clear root cause and established patterns in the codebase (generic fallback code provides the exact template to follow)
